name: Gescher (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Gescher (two white curved figures on green).
history: By deed of the Bezirksregierung Münster of 20 January 1971 the city was granted the right to bear arms and a flag, described as green, white and green in three stripes 1:3:1 with the arms.

features.role: Gescher arms — two white figures on green
